timing_notes.final_training_seconds: Includes StandardScaler fitting, feature transformation and SVC fitting on all 5,600 Training records.
timing_notes.testing_prediction_seconds: Includes StandardScaler transformation and SVC prediction for the 1,598 pre-extracted Testing feature vectors.
timing_notes.feature_extraction: HOG and GLCM Testing feature extraction was performed previously and is not included in the model prediction timing.
timing_notes.decision_scores: Decision scores are uncalibrated SVM scores, not class probabilities.
